channel.title: PAGASA NCRPRSD Advisories
channel.description: Aggregated rainfall, thunderstorm, and special forecasts from PAGASA NCRPRSD

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 3:40 PM, 09 October 2026(Friday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Quezon (Guinayangan, Calauag, Buenavista, Lopez, San Narciso, San Andres, San Francisco, Mulanay, Catanauan, General Luna, Macalelon, Jomalig, and Quezon) within the next 3 hours.

The above condition is affecting Quezon (Tagkawayan) which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
